decisions.reason: The schlager compilation is a label release the firm produced and publicly presented, and keeping it in the warehouse-backed catalog costs little, so management is inclined to keep it listed despite the lack of visible results.
The illustrated release series is a multi-model product line that embodies the firm's curation identity and carries substantial investment and visible commitment, so management will persist with it.
The jazz vinyl reissue sits at the core of the firm's announced reissue expertise, and vinyl demand is strong, so the investment and strategic fit argue for keeping it.
The box set was a costly, prominently presented edition, so sunk production costs and the need to justify it lead management to keep selling remaining stock.
The compilation CD was only mentioned rather than featured, which means weaker visible commitment, but it was a low-cost catalog item and sell-through via the shop still favors keeping it.
